infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ripple uses the camera to photograph water conditions as part of a reading you submit.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lets you attach an existing photo to a water-quality reading.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ripple records your location only at the moment you submit a reading, so your conservation group knows where on the lake it was taken. Ripple never tracks your location in the background.
